listen.description: Whether to run ncat in listen mode (server) or connect mode (client).

bind_address.description: The address to bind to in listen mode. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

port.description: The port number to listen on or connect to.

remote_host.description: The hostname or IP address to connect to in connect mode.

remote_port.description: The port number to connect to in connect mode.

use_ipv4.description: Force the use of IPv4 only.

use_ipv6.description: Force the use of IPv6 only.

use_udp.description: Use UDP instead of the default TCP.

use_ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the connection.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the PEM-encoded SSL certificate file.

ssl_key.description: Path to the PEM-encoded SSL private key file.

keep_open.description: Accept multiple connections in listen mode.

allow_list.description: List of hosts allowed to connect. Supports Nmap syntax.

deny_list.description: List of hosts denied from connecting. Supports Nmap syntax.

command.description: Command to execute after connection is established (using -e).

nodns.description: Do not resolve hostnames via DNS.

proxy_host.description: Proxy server address to connect through.

recv_only.description: Only receive data, never send anything.

output_file.description: File to dump session data to.

hex_dump_file.description: File to dump session data as hex to.

append_output.description: Append output files rather than clobbering them.

ssl_verify.description: Verify server certificates in client mode.

ssl_trustfile.description: PEM file containing trusted SSL certificates.

ssl_servername.description: Request distinct server name (SNI) in client mode.

proxy_dns.description: Where to resolve proxy destination (local, remote, both, none).

delay.description: Delay interval for lines sent in seconds.

no_shutdown.description: Do not shutdown socket on EOF.

zero_io.description: Zero-I/O mode, report connection status only.

source_routing_hops.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames for loose source routing.

source_routing_pointer.description: Source routing pointer for loose source routing.

lua_exec.description: Lua script file to execute after connection.
